# Commercial Coatings Coach

> Business coaching for owners of commercial and industrial roof-coating / restoration-coating contracting companies. Sales, estimating, crew operations, marketing, and scaling systems built specifically for this trade — not generic small-business coaching.

Commercial Coatings Coach is backed by Contractors Choice Agency's 20+ years of former-contractor experience. Programs address the specific sales cycle, bid math, and crew-operations challenges of commercial coatings work.

## Programs
- [Sales & Closing Coaching](https://www.commercialcoatingscoach.com/programs/sales-closing-coaching)
- [Estimating & Bidding Systems](https://www.commercialcoatingscoach.com/programs/estimating-bidding-systems)
- [Crew Operations & Production Coaching](https://www.commercialcoatingscoach.com/programs/crew-operations-coaching)
- [Marketing & Lead Generation for Coatings Contractors](https://www.commercialcoatingscoach.com/programs/marketing-lead-generation)
- [Business Systems & Scaling](https://www.commercialcoatingscoach.com/programs/business-systems-scaling)
- [One-on-One Coaching](https://www.commercialcoatingscoach.com/programs/one-on-one-coaching)
- [Group Coaching Mastermind](https://www.commercialcoatingscoach.com/programs/group-mastermind)
